words.definition: n. 收银员，出纳 v.（军）开除

examples.en: The cashier rang up my groceries.
examples.zh: 收银员给我结了账。

examples.en: He was cashiered from the army for negligence.
examples.zh: 他因玩忽职守被军队开除。

words.usage: cashier at the supermarket（超市收银员）高频；重音在后 kæˈʃɪə；动词义「开除」书面/军事；cash（现金）+ ier → 管钱的人。
words.mnemonic: cash（现金）+ier → 收银员

words.definition: n. 饥荒；短缺

examples.en: Thousands of people died during the great famine.
examples.zh: 大饥荒期间数千人丧生。

examples.en: There is a famine of good teachers in rural areas.
examples.zh: 农村地区严重缺乏好老师。

words.usage: suffer/widespread famine（遭遇饥荒/大范围饥荒）高频；比喻义 a famine of（…严重短缺）；词根 fam（饥饿）同 famished 饿极的；与 drought（旱灾）等灾难题材共现。
collocations: a famine of 严重缺乏
words.mnemonic: fam（饿）+ine → 饿殍遍野 → 饥荒

words.definition: v. 背诵，朗诵；逐一列举

examples.en: The child recited a poem from memory.
examples.zh: 孩子凭记忆背诵了一首诗。

examples.en: She recited all the reasons for rejecting the offer.
examples.zh: 她一一列举了拒绝该提议的理由。

words.usage: recite a poem/list（背诗/数说清单）；recitation n. 背诵；cite（引用）形近；re（再）+ cite（唤起）→ 重新唤出 → 背诵。
collocations: recite from memory 凭记忆背诵
recite the facts 逐一陈述事实
words.mnemonic: re(再)+cite(唤)→ 重新唤出 → 背诵

words.definition: v. 逐渐削弱；暗中破坏

examples.en: The scandal undermined public trust in the government.
examples.zh: 丑闻逐渐削弱了公众对政府的信任。

examples.en: Constant criticism undermined her confidence.
examples.zh: 不断的批评渐渐摧毁了她的自信。

words.usage: undermine confidence/support/authority（削弱信心/支持/权威）写作高频；under（在下）+ mine（挖）→ 挖墙脚；无被动进行时常用主动。
words.mnemonic: under(下)+mine(挖)→ 挖墙脚 → 暗中削弱

words.definition: n. 围巾，头巾，披巾 v.（口语）狼吞虎咽

examples.en: She wrapped a woollen scarf around her neck.
examples.zh: 她脖子上围了条羊毛围巾。

examples.en: The kids scarfed down their lunch in minutes.
examples.zh: 孩子们几分钟就把午饭狼吞虎咽吃完了。

words.usage: 复数 scarves/scarfs；wrap a scarf（围围巾）；scarf down（狼吞虎咽）口语高频；与 scarf joint（木工斜接）技术义少用。
words.mnemonic: 围巾绕脖防疤冻 → scarf

words.definition: n. 接待处；招待会；接收（效果）；迎接

examples.en: Leave your key at the reception when you go out.
examples.zh: 外出时把钥匙留在前台。

examples.en: The delegation was given a warm reception.
examples.zh: 代表团受到热烈接待。

words.usage: reception desk/ist（前台/接待员）；a warm/cool reception（热烈的/冷淡的接待）；good reception（信号接收良好）；receptionist 前台接待。

confusables.note: perception 感知，per- 同头形近

collocations: hold a reception 举行招待会
a warm reception 热情接待
words.mnemonic: re(回)+ception(接)→ 迎回客人 → 接待

words.definition: n. 气味，香味；（动物的）气息；踪迹 v. 嗅到；察觉

examples.en: The hounds followed the scent of the fox.
examples.zh: 猎犬循着狐狸的气味追踪。

examples.en: The room was filled with the scent of roses.
examples.zh: 房间里弥漫着玫瑰花香。

words.usage: on the scent of（循着线索）比喻高频；throw sb off the scent（使某人失去线索）；scented（带香味的：scented candles 香薰蜡烛）。
collocations: follow the scent 循着气味
throw off the scent 摆脱追踪
words.mnemonic: sent+香 → 闻到的 sent

words.definition: n. 大灾难，灾祸；（口语）惨败

examples.en: The oil spill was an environmental catastrophe.
examples.zh: 这次石油泄漏是一场环境灾难。

examples.en: Losing the data would be a catastrophe for the firm.
examples.zh: 数据丢失对公司将是灭顶之灾。

words.usage: natural catastrophe（自然灾害）；catastrophic adj. 灾难性的（catastrophic failure）；比 disaster 程度更重；catastrophe theory 突变论。
words.mnemonic: cata(下)+strophe(转)→ 天翻地覆 → 大灾

words.definition: n. 学者；奖学金获得者

examples.en: He is a visiting scholar at Beijing University.
examples.zh: 他是北京大学的访问学者。

examples.en: She won a scholarship to study abroad as an outstanding scholar.
examples.zh: 作为优秀学生她获奖学金出国深造。

words.usage: visiting scholar（访问学者）、Rhodes scholar（罗德学者）高频；scholarly adj. 学术的（scholarly journal 学术期刊）；scholarship n. 学问；奖学金。
collocations: win a scholarship 获得奖学金
words.mnemonic: school 里的高人 → 学者

words.definition: n. 一批，一组，一炉

examples.en: The bakery produces three batches of bread a day.
examples.zh: 面包房每天烤三炉面包。

examples.en: A new batch of applications arrived this week.
examples.zh: 本周收到了新的一批申请。

words.usage: a batch of（一批）；batch processing（批处理）计算机高频；in batches（分批地）；batch number 批号。
words.mnemonic: 一炉出炉一批 batch

words.definition: adj. 可以吃的，可食用的

examples.en: These wild mushrooms are edible, but those are not.
examples.zh: 这些野蘑菇可以吃，那些不行。

examples.en: The cake was decorated with edible flowers.
examples.zh: 蛋糕用可食用花卉装饰。

words.usage: edible oil/fungi（食用油/食用菌）高频；edibility n. 可食性；ed（吃）词根同 eat；反义 inedible（不可食用的）。

confusables.note: editable 可编辑的，edit 形近

words.mnemonic: ed（吃）+ible → 能吃的

words.definition: n. 熟人；相识，浅交；了解

examples.en: He is an old acquaintance from my university days.
examples.zh: 他是我大学时代的一位老熟人。

examples.en: I have a passing acquaintance with Japanese.
examples.zh: 我对日语略知一二。

words.usage: make sb's acquaintance（结识某人）高频；a passing/nodding acquaintance（点头之交；略知）；acquaint v. 使熟悉（acquaint sb with sth）。
collocations: make sb's acquaintance 结识某人
a passing acquaintance 点头之交
words.mnemonic: ac+quaint 相识之缘

words.definition: n. 药片；平板电脑；碑，匾

examples.en: Take two tablets after each meal.
examples.zh: 每餐后服两片药。

examples.en: Students use tablets instead of textbooks now.
examples.zh: 现在学生用平板电脑代替课本。

words.usage: take tablets（服药）；tablet computer（平板电脑）；commemorative tablet（纪念匾额）；与 pill（小圆药丸）、capsule（胶囊）辨析。
words.mnemonic: tablet 小板 → 药片；平板

words.definition: v. 撒，撒播；使散开 n. 散落

examples.en: The farmer scattered seeds across the field.
examples.zh: 农民把种子撒在田里。

examples.en: The crowd scattered at the sound of gunfire.
examples.zh: 枪声一响人群四散。

words.usage: scatter sth with/over（把…撒在）；scattered（分散的：scattered showers 零星阵雨）天气高频；与 spread（铺开）、disperse（驱散）辨析。
collocations: scatter in all directions 四散奔逃
words.mnemonic: scat 四散跑开 → 撒开

words.definition: n. 蒸汽，水汽（美拼 vapor）

examples.en: Water vapour condensed on the cold window.
examples.zh: 水汽在冰冷的窗上凝结。

examples.en: The locomotive belched clouds of vapour.
examples.zh: 机车喷出团团蒸汽。

words.usage: water vapour（水蒸气）科学高频；vaporize v. 蒸发；vapo(u)rize；美式一律 vapor；与 steam（蒸气，滚烫）、mist（薄雾）辨析。
words.mnemonic: vapor 英加 our 气足

words.definition: n. 禁忌，忌讳 adj. 禁忌的

examples.en: Death was a taboo subject in her family.
examples.zh: 在她家，死亡是个忌讳话题。

examples.en: Asking a woman's age is taboo in some cultures.
examples.zh: 在某些文化中，问女士年龄是禁忌。

words.usage: taboo subject/word（禁忌话题/词）高频；break a taboo（打破禁忌）；源自太平洋岛屿语言 tapua；复数 taboos。

confusables.note: tattoo 纹身，t- 同头形近

collocations: break a taboo 打破禁忌
words.mnemonic: ta-boo 避讳喊boo → 禁忌

words.definition: adj. 有磁性的；磁化的；有吸引力的

examples.en: The north pole of a magnet repels magnetic objects.
examples.zh: 磁铁北极排斥磁性物体。

examples.en: She has a magnetic personality.
examples.zh: 她个性极具魅力。

words.usage: magnetic field/force/north（磁场/磁力/磁北）物理高频；比喻「吸引人的」a magnetic smile；magnetism n. 磁性；魅力。
words.mnemonic: magnet 磁铁的 → 有磁力

words.definition: n. 誓言，宣誓；咒骂

examples.en: The witness swore an oath to tell the truth.
examples.zh: 证人宣誓说真话。

examples.en: The president took the oath of office today.
examples.zh: 总统今天宣誓就职。

words.usage: take/swear an oath（宣誓）高频；oath of office/allegiance（就职/效忠誓言）；under oath（经宣誓）；复数 oaths；与 clothe→clothed 类比加 th。
collocations: oath of office 就职宣誓
words.mnemonic: oath 誓言一诺千金

words.definition: adj. 服从的，顺从的

examples.en: The obedient dog sat when told.
examples.zh: 听话的狗一声令下就坐下。

examples.en: Obedient children are not always happy children.
examples.zh: 顺从的孩子未必快乐。

words.usage: be obedient to（顺从…）固定搭配；obedience n. 服从；obey v. 服从；obediently adv.；与 obstinate（固执的）形近义反。
words.mnemonic: obey（服从）的形容词 → obedient

words.definition: adj. 全体一致的，一致同意的

examples.en: The jury reached a unanimous verdict.
examples.zh: 陪审团达成一致裁决。

examples.en: She was elected by a unanimous vote.
examples.zh: 她以全票当选。

words.usage: be unanimous in（在…上意见一致）；unanimously adv. 全体一致地；un（一）+ anim（心神）→ 一条心；常与 vote/decision/verdict 连用。

confusables.note: anonymous 匿名的，-ymous 同尾形近

collocations: be unanimous in 在…上一致
words.mnemonic: un(一)+anim(心)→ 同心 → 一致
